notes: Locked narration for the Priora vision film. `text` is the displayed text (captions, SCRIPT.md). `tts_text` holds the spoken form per engine when it differs; every spoken form keeps exactly one whitespace token per displayed token so word timings map back one to one. `gap_after` is designed silence after the line, `pre_gap` designed silence before it, both measured speech to speech. `guide_inner_pauses` are the pauses the local guide voice inserts between the sentences of a line (the ElevenLabs performance supplies its own).

Roof 03.note: Zero is said oh, British usage. Applied in tts_text of L06 and L13 for both engines.

Priora.note: See pronunciations.Priora for the per-engine mechanism.

Priora.intent: pri-OR-a, stress on the middle syllable, never PRY-ora
aligner_right: P R IY AO R AH
P R IH AO R AH
aligner_wrong: P R AY AO R AH

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every industrial site changes by the hour.
lines.delivery: Quiet, observational opening. Unhurried, no announcer lift.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Contractors arrive. Equipment is isolated. Work moves.
lines.delivery: Three plain observations, even weight, the site coming alive.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Insurance sets conditions under which risk is accepted.
lines.delivery: Matter of fact. Slight weight on conditions and accepted.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Good teams translate them into permits, briefings and checklists.
lines.delivery: Respectful of the teams. The list is competent, not tired.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But no one can hold a moving site in their head.
lines.delivery: The turn. Human and understanding, not critical.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: On Roof 03, hot work begins. The certificate and safeguards are in place.

tts_text.guide: On Roof oh-three, hot work begins. The certificate and safeguards are in place.
tts_text.elevenlabs: On Roof oh-three, hot work begins. The certificate and safeguards are in place.

lines.delivery: Specific and calm. Everything is correct at this point.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then a sprinkler zone goes offline.
lines.delivery: Understated. No drama in the voice; the silence after it does the work.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nothing looks different. Work continues. But the conditions have changed, and nobody sees it.
lines.delivery: Controlled tension. Short beats, then the quiet realisation on nobody sees it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: If something goes wrong, questions begin afterwards:
lines.delivery: Restrained. Leads straight into the questions.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: What was happening? Which condition applied? Can you prove what was true?
lines.delivery: Forensic. Each question stands alone, slightly more pointed each time.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Today, the gap is often discovered too late.
lines.delivery: Land the idea. Plain, final, no sigh.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: What if the decision existed when the risk changed?
lines.delivery: After the rewind silence. Open, curious, forward looking.
lines.pre_gap_note: REWIND SILENCE: picture and sound reverse here

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: I'm welding on Roof 03 until six.

tts_text.guide: I'm welding on Roof oh-three until six.
tts_text.elevenlabs: I'm welding on Roof oh-three until six.

lines.delivery: A real worker speaking into a phone on site. Natural, close-mic, practical, not a slogan.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Priora connects the activity to the conditions that matter, verifies the certificate and safeguards, and creates the record while work happens.

tts_text.guide: Priora connects the activity to the conditions that matter, verifies the certificate and safeguards, and creates the record while work happens.
tts_text.elevenlabs: Pree-OR-uh connects the activity to the conditions that matter, verifies the certificate and safeguards, and creates the record while work happens.

lines.delivery: Clarity arrives. Precise, even, three clauses with light separation.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Prevention before the work. Proof as it happens.
lines.delivery: Let each half stand. Confident through precision, not emphasis.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: When the sprinkler goes offline again, Priora sees it immediately.

tts_text.guide: When the sprinkler goes offline again, Priora sees it immediately.
tts_text.elevenlabs: When the sprinkler goes offline again, Pree-OR-uh sees it immediately.

lines.delivery: Calm certainty. Immediately is quiet, not triumphant.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Now the risk owner can change the activity, knowingly retain the exposure, or eventually ask selected carriers whether they will cover it.
lines.delivery: Three options with momentum. Eventually is honest and unhurried.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Most work remains ordinary. A few changes become explicit decisions.
lines.delivery: Pulling back. Reassuring, measured.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Record becomes trust.
lines.delivery: Chain link one. Even, deliberate.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Trust enables decisions.
lines.delivery: Chain link two.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Decisions can carry price.
lines.delivery: Chain link three. Can is conditional, not a promise.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Price can connect to capacity.
lines.delivery: Chain link four. Resolve downward.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Priora. Infrastructure for activity-level physical risk.

tts_text.guide: Priora. Infrastructure for activity-level physical risk.
tts_text.elevenlabs: Pree-OR-uh. Infrastructure for activity-level physical risk.

lines.delivery: Calm, inevitable close. The name, a breath, the descriptor.
